# Tiket (טיקט)

> Tiket (טיקט, tiket.co.il) is an Israeli marketplace for buying and selling second-hand tickets to concerts, theatre, stand-up and sports events. Every ticket is checked as valid with the event's ticketing system before it is listed and is transferred into the buyer's name after purchase, so it cannot be used or resold by the seller. The buyer's payment is held in escrow and released to the seller only after the event, and a cancelled event means a full refund. Tiket is in early access and launching soon; people can join the waitlist at https://tiket.co.il/.

Tiket is built as the safe alternative to buying tickets from strangers in Facebook groups, Telegram channels and WhatsApp, where common scams are a seller who takes a Bit/PayBox payment and disappears, a fake screenshot of a ticket, or one ticket sold to several buyers.

## Key facts

- What: second-hand ticket resale (כרטיסים יד שנייה) for events in Israel, including sold-out shows (הופעות סולד אאוט)
- Sellers: upload a ticket, it is checked as valid with the event's ticketing system and listed; payout arrives 5-7 days after the event
- Buyers: pay on the platform; the ticket is transferred into their name; money is held in escrow until after the event; full refund if the event is cancelled
- Cost: free to join the early-access list; a service fee is charged on each purchase and shown before payment
- Status: early access, launching soon
- Language: Hebrew (RTL)
